description: Source-documented V2 deployments across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon, Avalanche, and BNB Smart Chain. DEX Screener IDs are discovery labels only. Addresses and fee assumptions are not treated as live verified until on-chain checks confirm pair.factory(), factory.getPair(), and router.factory() at the pinned block.

venues.name: Uniswap V2
venues.notes: The total V2 swap fee is 0.30% (30 bps). The current protocol-fee split changes how that fee is distributed, not the total trader swap fee. Verify factory, pair, and router on-chain at the pinned block before using.

venues.name: SushiSwap V2
venues.notes: The Sushi V2 pair invariant applies a 3/1000 input deduction (30 bps). Verify factory, pair, and router on-chain at the pinned block before using.

venues.name: PancakeSwap V2
venues.notes: BNB Smart Chain mainnet V2. Factory and router are documented/verified public contracts. V2 pool fee assumed 25 bps from PancakeSwap documentation; verify router/factory bindings and live pair at the requested block before use.

venues.name: ApeSwap V2
venues.notes: BNB Smart Chain mainnet V2. Official ApeSwap repository lists factory/router deployments. 20 bps pool fee is documented in the cited audit; treat as an assumption until current fee configuration is verified on-chain.
